changelog: **Native push: no registration loop, explanation before the permission prompt (#2775):** on Android, expo-notifications re-emits `onDevicePushToken` on every token fetch, so the `addPushTokenListener` handler that re-registered on each event looped — about 24 `POST /api/push/native` a second on the emulator. `deviceTokenEvent()` (`apps/mobile/src/lib/push.ts`, unit-tested) now records the first token and re-registers only on a real change, and `registerPush` runs one registration per host at a time. The `messages` channel is created only after the person agrees to the explanation (or permission is already granted), because creating it first let Android show its own prompt and the explanation never appeared. Verified on the emulator: delivery in the background and with the process dead, and a tap routes to the Messages tab, the Notifications tab and the native thread, cold start included (release build — the dev client swallows the launch intent). `docs/mobile-push.md` gains the test notes and the `eas credentials`-from-the-repo-root trap.
